title: 知鱼亭 Zhiyu Ting
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: A plain box on the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class. It will be updated as the research goes on.
rows: platform 0.48 m, eave 3.68 m, ridge 6.24 m above the ground

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 坦坦荡荡
evidence.excerpt_zh: 杏花春館之西度碧瀾橋為坦坦蕩蕩三楹前宇為素心堂後宇為光風霽月堂東北為知魚亭又東北為萃景齋西北為雙佳齋（圓明園冊）臣等謹按坦坦蕩蕩四十景之一也額為皇上御書聨曰源頭句詠朱夫子池上居同白樂天素心堂内額曰清虚靜泰與光風霽月萃景齋諸額皆御書知魚亭及雙佳齋額世宗御書萃景齋石上刋御製坦坦蕩蕩詩
evidence.summary: West over the 碧瀾橋: 坦坦蕩蕩 of three bays, 素心堂 in front, 光風霽月堂 behind, with 知魚亭, 萃景齋 and 雙佳齋 around. The poem is cut on a rock at 萃景齋.

evidence.title: 知鱼亭待月（328）
evidence.locator: v2 p.44, under 坦坦荡荡
evidence.excerpt_zh: 传呼不用上林丞，傍水登临远郁蒸。解渴漫调金掌露，清心胜饮玉壶冰。知鱼亭畔观鱼跃，得月台前望月升。烟敛碧池星汉皎，玉栏高处尽堪凭。
evidence.summary: Poem 知鱼亭待月（328） by the  Emperor, filed by the editors under 坦坦荡荡.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
